paragraphs: IRADIMED CORPORATION ("IRadimed", the "Company," "we," "us," "our" or similar terms) develops, manufactures, markets and distributes Magnetic Resonance Imaging ("MRI") compatible medical devices and related accessories, disposables and services relating to them. We were originally incorporated in Oklahoma under the name IRI Development, Inc. in 1992, and we merged our Oklahoma corporation into the newly formed Delaware corporation, IRADIMED CORPORATION, in April 2014.

We are the only known provider of a non-magnetic intravenous ("IV") infusion pump system that is specifically designed to be safe for use during MRI procedures and operates dependably in magnetic fields up to 15,000 gauss. We were the first to develop an infusion delivery system that largely eliminates many of the dangers and problems present during MRI procedures. Standard infusion pumps contain magnetic and electronic components which can create radio frequency interference and are dangerous to operate in the presence of the powerful magnet that drives an MRI system. Our patented MRidium 3870 MRI Compatible IV Infusion Pump System, introduced in 2025, has been designed with a non-magnetic ultrasonic motor, uniquely designed non-ferrous parts, touch screen user interface, and other special features to safely and predictably deliver anesthesia and other critical care IV fluids during various MRI procedures. Our pump solution provides a seamless approach that enables accurate, safe and dependable fluid delivery before, during and after an MRI scan, which is important to critically ill patients who cannot be removed from their vital medications, and children and infants who must generally be sedated to remain immobile during an MRI scan.

The MRidium 3870 IV Infusion Pump System consists of the MRidium 3870 MRI Compatible IV Infusion Pump, a non-magnetic IV pole mounting system, a non-magnetic mobile IV pole stand, proprietary disposable IV tubing sets and other options including a Remote Display Unit. The optional MRidium 3875 Remote Display Unit provides the clinical user with continuous visual, audible, and remote control of the MRidium 3870 MRI Infusion Pump(s) from within the MRI Control Room, allowing the user to control the Infusion Pump(s) without the need to disrupt an active MRI scan by entering the MRI System Room.

Our patented MRidium 3860+ IV Infusion Pump System has been designed with a non-magnetic ultrasonic motor, uniquely designed non-ferrous parts and other special features to safely and predictably deliver anesthesia and other IV fluids during various MRI procedures. Our pump solution provides a seamless approach that enables accurate, safe and dependable fluid delivery before, during and after an MRI scan, which is important to critically ill patients who cannot be removed from their vital medications, and children and infants who must generally be sedated to remain immobile during an MRI scan.

The MRidium 3860+ IV Infusion Pump System consists of an MRidium MRI compatible IV infusion pump, non-magnetic mobile stand, proprietary disposable IV tubing sets and many of these systems contain additional optional upgrade accessories. New MRidium 3860+ Pump System sales will be discontinued during 2026, with continued warranty and technical support continuing through applicable contracted periods.

Our 3880 MRI compatible patient vital signs monitoring system has been designed with non-magnetic components and other special features to safely and accurately monitor a patient's vital signs during various MRI procedures. The IRadimed 3880 system operates dependably in magnetic fields up to 30,000 gauss, which means it can operate virtually anywhere in the MRI scanner room. The IRadimed 3880 has a compact, lightweight design allowing it to travel with the patient from their critical care unit to the MRI and back, resulting in increased patient safety through uninterrupted vital signs monitoring and decreasing the amount of time critically ill patients are away from critical care units. The features of the IRadimed 3880 include: wireless Electrocardiogram ("ECG") with dynamic gradient filtering; wireless blood oxygen saturation monitoring ("SpO2") using Masimo® algorithms; non-magnetic respiratory carbon dioxide ("CO2"); invasive and non-invasive blood pressure; patient temperature; and optional advanced multi-gas anesthetic agent unit featuring continuous Minimum Alveolar Concentration measurements. The IRadimed 3880 MRI compatible patient vital signs monitoring system has an easy-to-use design and allows for the effective communication of patient vital signs information to clinicians.

With the expanding use of MRI procedures, both traditional procedures, and intraoperative and interventional procedures, safe and reliable infusion delivery and patient monitoring in an MRI environment is becoming increasingly important to hospitals and other medical providers. Our founder, President, Chief Executive Officer, and Chairman of our Board of Directors (the "Board" or the "Board of Directors"), Roger Susi, is a pioneer in the MRI compatible medical device industry, having invented the first MRI compatible patient monitoring system in 1986 and the first non-magnetic MRI compatible IV infusion pump system in 2004.

We sell our products primarily to hospitals and acute care facilities, both in the United States and internationally. We currently employ a direct sales strategy in the United States and as of December 31, 2025, our direct sales force consisted of 29 field sales representatives, supported by 4 regional sales directors, and supplemented by 10 clinical application specialists. Internationally, we market our products into approximately 80 countries through the use of independent distributors.
As of December 31, 2025, we have sold approximately 13,098 MRI compatible IV infusion pump system channels and approximately 3,397 of our 3880 MRI compatible patient vital signs monitoring systems.

We generate revenue from the sale of these and other MRI compatible medical devices and related accessories, extended maintenance agreements, services related to maintaining our products and the sale of disposable products used with our devices. In fiscal year 2025, our revenue was $83.8 million and our income from operations was $26.1 million representing an operating profit margin of approximately 31.2 percent. Refer to the information contained under the caption "Financial Highlights and Outlook" regarding our outlook for fiscal year 2026.

Mr. Susi founded Invivo Research Inc. ("Invivo Research") in 1979 where he developed the first MRI compatible patient monitoring system. Mr. Susi served as the President of Invivo Research from 1979 until 1998, and as its Chairman of the Board of Directors from 1998 until 2000. Under Mr. Susi's leadership, Invivo Research matured from a start-up medical device company into a leading producer of vital signs monitoring devices used during MRI procedures. Invivo Research was acquired by Invivo Corporation ("Invivo") in 1992, which began trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market in 1994. Mr. Susi served as a Director of Invivo from 1998 until 2000 and oversaw technical areas from 2000 to 2004. Invivo was acquired by Intermagnetics General Corporation in 2004, which was later acquired by Koninklijke Philips NV (NYSE: PHG).

Mr. Susi began exploring the market for an MRI compatible IV infusion pump while at Invivo. Invivo subsequently disclaimed any interest in the infusion pump and acknowledged that Mr. Susi was free to pursue the infusion pump development for his own account. Accordingly, Mr. Susi began the formal and detailed development of what subsequently became our 3850 MRidium MRI compatible IV infusion pump system. This first-generation MRI compatible IV infusion pump system and its associated proprietary IV tubing sets obtained FDA 510(k) clearance in
March 2005 after which we began our sales and marketing efforts. The 3860+ infusion pump system was introduced in 2009.

In May 2025, we received FDA 510(k) clearance for our new MRidium 3870 IV infusion pump system and completed our first customer shipment in December 2025. Our MRidium 3870 and 3860+ are the only MRI compatible IV infusion pump systems on the market today.

headings: Risk Factors Summary
Risks Relating to Our Business and Financial Condition
Our financial performance is significantly dependent on a limited number of products, and disruptions in our ability to sell these products may have a material adverse effect on our business.

Our continued success depends on the integrity of our supply chain and unaffiliated third-party suppliers for certain of our raw materials and components, the disruption of which could negatively impact our business.
The manufacture of our products requires strict adherence to regulatory requirements governing medical devices and if we or our suppliers encounter problems our business could suffer.
Our markets are very competitive, and we sell certain of our products in a mature market.
We manufacture and store our products at a single facility in Florida.
If we fail to maintain relationships with IDNs and GPOs, sales of our products could decline.
The lengthy sales cycle for medical devices could delay our sales.

If we do not successfully develop and commercialize enhanced products or new products that remain competitive, we could lose revenue opportunities and customers, and our ability to achieve growth would be impaired.
We are highly dependent on our founder, Chairman of the Board of Directors, President and Chief Executive Officer, Roger Susi.
We may be unable to scale our operations successfully.
The environment in which we operate makes it difficult to accurately forecast our business performance.
Changes in effective tax rates or adverse outcomes resulting from examination of our income or other tax returns could adversely affect our results.
The constant growth and development of technology, including the increased use of AI, presents
risks and challenges to our operations that could give rise to legal or regulatory action, damage our reputation or otherwise materially harm of our business.
Our financial condition, results of operations and cash flow may be adversely affected by changing economic
conditions, including interest rates and inflation, and other factors beyond our control.
Risks Related to Our Industry

We are subject to substantial government regulation and trade policies that are subject to change and could force us to make modifications to how we develop, manufacture, market, and price our products.

If we fail to obtain, or experience significant delays in obtaining, FDA clearances or other necessary approvals to commercially distribute new products, our ability to maintain profitability or grow will suffer.
We are subject to risks associated with doing business outside of the U.S.
We may incur product liability losses or become subject to other lawsuits related to our products, business, and insurance coverage could be inadequate or unavailable to cover these losses.
U.S. healthcare policy and changes thereto, including the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, may have a material adverse effect on our financial condition and results of operations.
We are subject to healthcare fraud and abuse regulations that could result in significant liability, require us to change our business practices and restrict our operations in the future.
We could be adversely affected by violations of the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and similar worldwide anti-bribery laws.
Risks Relating to our Intellectual Property
Our success depends on our ability to protect our intellectual property, unpatented trade secrets, know-how, confidential and proprietary information, and technology.
There can be no assurance of timely patent review and approval that would minimize competition and allow us to generate sufficient revenues.

paragraphs: IRADIMED CORPORATION ("IRadimed", the "Company," "we," "us," "our" or similar terms) 開發、製造、行銷與分銷與磁共振影像 ("MRI") 兼容的醫療器材與相關配件、消耗品及相關服務。我們最初於奧克拉荷馬州以 IRI Development, Inc. 名稱成立，於 1992 年成立，並於 2014 年 4 月將奧克拉荷馬州公司併入新成立的特拉華州公司 IRADIMED CORPORATION。

我們是唯一已知提供非磁性靜脈注射 ("IV") 電動泵系統的供應商，該系統專門設計為可在 MRI 程序中安全使用，並能在磁場達 15,000 高斯時可靠運作。我們是首個開發出可大幅消除 MRI 程序中許多危險與問題的輸液系統的公司。標準輸液泵含有磁性與電子零組件，可能產生無線電頻率幹擾，且在強大磁鐵存在下運作時具危險性。我們的專利 MRidium 3870 MRI 兼容 IV 電動泵系統，於 2025 年推出，設計為具非磁性超聲波馬達、獨特設計的非鐵磁性零件、觸控螢幕使用者介面及其他特殊功能，以在各種 MRI 程序中安全且預測性地輸送麻醉劑及其他關鍵照護 IV 液體。我們的泵解決方案提供一種無縫方法，使在 MRI 檢測前、中、後都能準確、安全且可靠地輸送液體，這對無法離開關鍵藥物的重症患者，以及必須一般麻醉以保持靜止的兒童與嬰兒而言非常重要。

MRidium 3870 IV 電動泵系統包含 MRidium 3870 MRI 兼容 IV 電動泵、非磁性 IV 橋架安裝系統、非磁性移動 IV 橋架支架、專利消耗性 IV 輸液管組及其他選購項目，包括遠端顯示單元。選購的 MRidium 3875 遠端顯示單元可讓臨牀使用者在 MRI 控制室內持續視覺、聲音及遠端控制 MRidium 3870 MRI 電動泵 (s)，無需進入 MRI 系統室以幹擾正在進行的 MRI 檢測即可控制電動泵 (s)。
我們的專利 MRidium 3860+ IV 電動泵系統設計為具非磁性超聲波馬達、獨特設計的非鐵磁性零件及其他特殊功能，以在各種 MRI 程序中安全且預測性地輸送麻醉劑及其他 IV 液體。我們的泵解決方案提供一種無縫方法，使在 MRI 檢測前、中、後都能準確、安全且可靠地輸送液體，這對無法離開關鍵藥物的重症患者，以及必須一般麻醉以保持靜止的兒童與嬰兒而言非常重要。
MRidium 3860+ IV 電動泵系統包含 MRidium MRI 兼容 IV 電動泵、非磁性移動支架、專利消耗性 IV 輸液管組，且許多這些系統包含額外選購的升級配件。新 MRidium 3860+ 電動泵系統銷售於 2026 年停止，但維修與技術支援將持續至適用的合約期間。

我們的 3880 MRI 兼容患者生命徵象監測系統設計為具非磁性零組件及其他特殊功能，以在各種 MRI 程序中安全且準確地監測患者的關鍵生命徵象。IRadimed 3880 系統可在磁場達 30,000 高斯時可靠運作，這意味著它可在 MRI 掃描室內幾乎任何地方運作。IRadimed 3880 具有緊湊輕便的設計，使其能隨患者從關鍵照護單位移動至 MRI 系統並返回，提高患者安全，透過無間斷的生命徵象監測，並減少重症患者離開關鍵照護單位的時間。IRadimed 3880 的功能包括：無線心電圖 ("ECG") 並具動態梯度過濾；使用 Masimo® 演算法的無線血氧飽和度監測 ("SpO2")；非磁性呼吸二氧化碳 ("CO2")；侵入性與非侵入性血壓；患者體溫；以及選購的先進多氣體麻醉劑單元，具連續最小肺泡濃度測量功能。IRadimed 3880 MRI 兼容患者生命徵象監測系統具備易用設計，並允許有效傳達患者生命徵象資訊至臨牀人員。
隨著 MRI 程序的使用增加，包括傳統程序、術中及介入程序，醫院及其他醫療機構在 MRI 環境中安全可靠地輸液與監測患者的需求正變得越來越重要。我們的創辦人、董事長、總裁及首席執行官 Roger Susi 是 MRI 兼容醫療器材產業的先驅，於 1986 年發明瞭首個 MRI 兼容患者監測系統，並於 2004 年發明瞭首個非磁性 MRI 兼容 IV 電動泵系統。
我們主要將產品銷售給美國與國際的醫院及急性照護機構。我們目前在美國採用直接銷售策略，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的直接銷售團隊由 29 名現場銷售代表組成，並由 4 名區域銷售經理支援，並由 10 名臨牀應用專員補充。國際上，我們透過獨立經銷商在約 80 個國家行銷產品。
截至2025年12月31日，我們已銷售約13,098個MRI相容的靜脈輸液泵系統通道，以及約3,397個我們的3880型MRI相容病患生命徵象監測系統。
本公司營收來自這些及其他與磁力共振成像（MRI）相容之醫療器材及相關配件、延長維護合約、維護產品之相關服務，以及用於本公司器材之消耗性產品之銷售。在會計年度 2025 年，本公司營收為 83.8 百萬美元，營業利益為 26.1 百萬美元，營業利益率約為 31.2%。請參閱「財務亮點與展望」部分之內容，以瞭解本公司對會計年度 2026 年之展望。

蘇西先生於1979年創立Invivo Research Inc.（"Invivo Research"），並開發出第一套MRI相容病患監測系統。蘇西先生自1979年至1998年擔任Invivo Research的總裁，並自1998年至2000年擔任董事會主席。在蘇西先生的領導下，Invivo Research從一家新創醫療器材公司成長為MRI程序中使用的生命徵象監測設備領導製造商。Invivo Research於1992年被Invivo Corporation（"Invivo"）收購，該公司於1994年開始在納斯達克資本市場交易。蘇西先生自1998年至2000年擔任Invivo董事，並自2000年至2004年 oversee 技術領域。Invivo於2004年被Intermagnetics General Corporation收購，後者於之後被Koninklijke Philips NV（紐約證券交易所：PHG）收購。
蘇西先生在擔任Invivo期間開始探索MRI相容靜脈輸液泵市場。Invivo隨後聲明對輸液泵毫無興趣，並承認蘇西先生可以自由為自己開發輸液泵。因此，蘇西先生開始正式且詳細地開發後來成為我們3850 MRidium MRI相容靜脈輸液泵系統的產品。這第一代MRI相容靜脈輸液泵系統及其相關專利IV管路組於
2005年3月獲得FDA 510(k)認可，之後我們開始進行銷售與行銷活動。3860+輸液泵系統於2009年推出。
我們於2025年5月獲得FDA 510(k)認可，批准我們新的MRidium 3870靜脈輸液泵系統，並於2025年12月完成首個客戶出貨。我們的MRidium 3870與3860+是目前市場上唯一MRI相容的靜脈輸液泵系統。

paragraphs: 您應配合本討論與分析，一併閱讀我們經審計的財務報表、財務報表附註，以及本 Form 10-K 所包含的其他財務資訊。本討論包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。由於許多因素，例如於「風險因素」節及本 Form 10-K 其他地方所列舉的那些因素，我們實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述所預期的有重大差異。請參閱「前瞻性陳述警示」以瞭解與這些陳述相關的不確定性、風險與假設。由於四捨五入，本處表格中的某些金額可能不會完全相加。
我們從事 MRI 兼容醫療器材與配件、一次性用品及相關服務的研發、製造、行銷與銷售。

我們在開發創新 MRI 兼容醫療器材方面為領導者。我們是唯一已知提供專為 MRI 程序中使用安全設計的非磁性 IV 靜脈輸液泵系統的供應商。我們是首創開發一種輸液輸送系統，大幅消除許多 MRI 程序中常見的危險與問題。標準輸液泵含有磁性與電子零組件，可能產生射頻幹擾，且在強大磁鐵存在下操作時會有危險。我們的專利 MRidium MRI 兼容 IV 輸液泵系統，設計有非磁性超聲波馬達、獨特設計的非鐵磁性零件及其他特殊功能，以安全且可預測的方式，在各種 MRI 程序中輸送麻醉劑及其他 IV 液體。我們的泵解決方案提供一種順暢的方法，使在 MRI 檢查前、中、後都能準確、安全且可靠地輸送液體，這對無法離開關鍵藥物的重症患者，以及必須在 MRI 檢查中保持靜止的兒童與嬰兒而言非常重要。
每個 IV 輸液泵系統通常包含一個 MRidium MRI 兼容 IV 輸液泵、非磁性移動支架、專利一次性 IV 管線組，且許多這些系統包含額外的選擇性升級配件。

我們的 3880 MRI 兼容患者生命徵象監測系統，設計有非磁性零組件及其他特殊功能，以安全且準確的方式在各種 MRI 程序中監測患者的關鍵生命徵象。IRadimed 3880 系統可在磁場強度達 30,000 高斯的環境中穩定運作，這意味著它幾乎可以在 MRI 掃描室的任何地方運作。IRadimed 3880 具有輕巧、便攜的設計，可隨患者從重症監護單位移動至 MRI 系統並返回，提高患者安全，透過無間斷的生命徵象監測，並減少重症患者離開重症監護單位的時間。IRadimed 3880 的功能包括：無線 ECG 並具動態梯度過濾；使用 Masimo® 演算法的無線 SpO2；非磁性呼吸 CO2；侵入式與非侵入式血壓；患者體溫；以及選擇性進階多氣體麻醉劑單元，具連續 Minimum Alveolar Concentration 測量功能。IRadimed 3880 MRI 兼容患者生命徵象監測系統具備易用設計，並允許有效傳達患者生命徵象資訊給醫療人員。
我們的收入來自 MRI 兼容醫療器材與配件的銷售、延長維護協議、維護產品的相關服務，以及與我們器材搭配使用的一次性產品銷售。我們 MRI 兼容產品的主要客戶包括美國與國際的醫院與急性照護機構。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的美國直接銷售團隊包含 29 名現場銷售代表、4 名區域銷售經理，並輔以 10 名臨牀應用專員。國際上，我們與獨立經銷商簽訂分銷協議，銷售我們的產品。
我們產品的銷售週期差異很大，歷史來看通常為三到六個月。我們也與 IDNs（整合式醫療系統）及醫療供應契約公司簽訂協議，這些公司在美國通常稱為 GPOs（集購組織），使我們能將產品銷售與分銷至其成員醫院。GPOs
為其成員醫院、集團診所及其他診所協商批量購買新價。根據我們的 GPO 協議，我們需支付 GPOs 三％的銷售費用，作為我們產品銷售給 GPO 成員的費用。銷售給參與 IDNs 的產品不涉及相關費用。
本公司營業收入為 83.8 百萬美元於 2025 年，以及 73.2 百萬美元於 2024 年。本公司稀釋後每股盈餘為 1.75 美元於 2025 年，以及 1.50 美元於 2024 年。本公司營運活動所產生之現金為 24.9 百萬美元於 2025 年，以及 25.6 百萬美元於 2024 年。

本公司從銷售 MRI 兼容醫療器材及配件、延長維護合約、與維護產品相關之服務，以及銷售用於本公司器材之一次性產品中產生收入。本公司 MRI 兼容產品的主要客戶包括美國與國際之醫院及急性照護機構。在美國，本公司透過本公司直接銷售團隊銷售產品；在美國以外地區，本公司透過第三方經銷商銷售產品，這些經銷商再將產品轉售給最終用戶。

headings: 風險因素總覽
與我們業務及財務狀況相關的風險
我們的財務表現嚴重依賴少數產品，若我們銷售這些產品的能力受到幹擾，可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
我們的持續成功依賴於供應鏈的完整性及無關聯第三方供應商對於我們部分原材料及零組件的供應，若供應受到幹擾，可能對我們的業務產生負面影響。
我們產品的製造需要嚴格遵守醫療器材的監管要求，若我們或我們的供應商遇到問題，我們的業務可能會受到影響。
我們的市場非常競爭，我們在某些產品的銷售屬於成熟市場。
我們在佛羅裏達州設有一處單一廠區用以製造及儲存產品。
若我們未能維持與IDNs及GPOs的關係，我們產品的銷售可能會下降。
醫療器材的長銷售週期可能延遲我們的銷售。
若我們未能成功開發並商業化具競爭力的增強型產品或新產品，我們可能失去營業收入機會與客戶，且我們實現成長的能力將受到影響。
我們高度依賴創辦人、董事會主席、總裁及首席執行官 Roger Susi。
我們可能無法成功擴展業務運作規模。
我們所處的環境使我們難以準確預測業務表現。
有效稅率的變動或因審查我們的所得或其他稅務申報而產生的不利結果，可能對我們的結果產生負面影響。
科技持續成長與發展，包括人工智能的使用增加，帶來
對我們運作的風險與挑戰，可能引發法律或監管行動，損害我們聲譽，或以其他方式對我們業務造成重大傷害。
本公司之財務狀況、營運成果及現金流可能因總體經濟情勢變動而受到不利影響，包括利率及通貨膨脹等，且其他因素亦可能超出本公司控制範圍。

產業相關風險
本公司受政府規範及貿易政策之重大影響，而這些規範及政策可能變動，並可能迫使本公司修改產品之研發、製造、行銷及定價方式。
若我們未能取得，或遭遇重大延誤取得 FDA 許可或其它必要核准以商業化推廣新產品，將影響我們維持獲利能力或成長的潛力。
我們面臨在美國境外從事業務所涉及的風險。
我們可能因產品、業務或保險覆蓋範圍不足或無法取得而產生產品責任損失，或成為其他訴訟的被告。
美國醫療保健政策及其變動，包括《病人保護與可負擔醫療照護法案》，可能對我們的財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。
本公司受制於醫療保健詐欺及濫用規範，可能導致重大賠償責任，要求本公司改變營運作法，並限制未來營運活動。
本公司可能因違反美國外國腐敗行為防治法及類似全球反賄款法而受到不利影響。
與智慧財產權相關的風險
本公司之成功取決於本公司保護智慧財產權、未經專利之商業機密、技術知識、機密及專屬資訊，以及技術之能力。
無法確保專利審查及核准之時程，此將無法降低競爭，並使本公司難以產生足夠收入。
